title: Ship-status reports an archived change's review as done by finalize and classifies its re-archive tip as archive-only
description: ship-status reports an archived change's review as done by finalize and classifies its re-archive tip as archive-only
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-cmd-change-007's tip class mirrors CI's archive-only lane, which counts the archived change's own package paths as archive work; SHIP-9.a names the one command when it is not time, never a review that refuses. Leif classed #1038 a bug fix on 2026-11-13: for an archived change, report the review as done by finalize and suggest nothing
acceptance_criteria: on an archived change whose archive authenticates, ship-status reports review_currency current with a finalize reason, a done review stage and no change review suggestion; an archive commit that also removes the archived change's own package files is archive_only, and another change's package beside it is product
